caption:
Already race GT7 on a T-GT II? The T-GT III swaps its belt-driven base for 5 Nm direct drive with peaks to 10, adds a load-cell brake, and lists at $749.99 from December 3. Not confirmed yet: how many pedals it has (two would mean no clutch) and what carries over from a T-GT II. From Thrustmaster's announcement, not a test. #granturismo7 #thrustmaster

What we know about the T-GT III, and what we don't: https://roomracer.com/parts/wheel-bases/thrustmaster-t-gt-iii?src=yt-event
title: Have a Thrustmaster T-GT II? What the T-GT III changes, and what isn't confirmed
